legend: A number N$$$N$$$ is called to be K$$$K$$$-binary repetitive if it's binary representation using K$$$K$$$ bits can be represented as a shorter binary string concatenated a number of times, for example, N=10$$$N=10$$$ is 4$$$4$$$-binary repetitive since it's binary representation with 4$$$4$$$ bits (1010$$$1010$$$) can be represented as concatenating the binary string 10$$$10$$$ to itself, but, it is not 5$$$5$$$-binary repetitive since its binary representation using 5$$$5$$$ bits 01010$$$01010$$$ can not be represented as a shorter binary string concatenated a number of times.
Given a number K$$$K$$$, can you find how many different numbers N$$$N$$$ are K$$$K$$$-binary repetitive?
input: The first line of input contains a single integer T$$$T$$$ (1≤T≤105$$$1 \leq T \leq 10^5$$$), the number of test cases. Each of the next T$$$T$$$ lines contains a single integer number K$$$K$$$ (1≤K≤106$$$1 \leq K \leq 10^6$$$).
output: For each test in the inpunt print a line containing one integer number, the number of different N$$$N$$$ that are K$$$K$$$-binary repetitive, since this number can be big print it modulo 109+7$$$10^9 + 7$$$.

legend.ai: 如果一个数 N$$$N$$$ 的 K$$$K$$$ 位二进制表示可以表示为某个更短的二进制字符串重复若干次拼接而成，则称其为 K$$$K$$$-二进制重复数。例如，N=10$$$N=10$$$ 是 4$$$4$$$-二进制重复数，因为它的 4$$$4$$$ 位二进制表示(1010$$$1010$$$)可以通过将二进制字符串 10$$$10$$$ 与自身拼接得到；但是，它不是 5$$$5$$$-二进制重复数，因为它使用 5$$$5$$$ 位的二进制表示 01010$$$01010$$$ 无法表示为某个更短的二进制字符串重复若干次拼接而成。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含一个整数 T$$$T$$$(1≤T≤105$$$1 \leq T \leq 10^5$$$)，表示测试用例的数量。接下来的 T$$$T$$$ 行中，每行包含一个整数 K$$$K$$$(1≤K≤106$$$1 \leq K \leq 10^6$$$)。

output.ai: 对于每个测试用例，输出一行，其中包含一个整数，即满足 K$$$K$$$-二进制重复条件的不同 N$$$N$$$ 的数量。由于这个数可能很大，请将其对 109+7$$$10^9 + 7$$$ 取模。
